Operator Journey
Cleaning Task Queue
Operator-guided workflow

Teach every toilet region without needing robotics knowledge.

ALIX Studio guides the operator from robot setup to region teaching, trajectory review, simulation validation and real-arm testing. Each step explains what to do now and what happens next.

Prototype rule: hardware buttons in this file demonstrate the intended workflow only. Backend/controller integration will be added after the template is approved.
1 · SETUP

Position & initialize

Power ON, move robot approximately 250 mm from the bowl, confirm preparation and move arms to chosen start poses.

2 · TEACH

Follow highlighted region

Choose LEFT or RIGHT first, set pole/hand, start drag recording and complete the region within the editable target time.

3 · VALIDATE

Tune & simulate

Save, replay, trim/smooth/scale if required, then inspect the trajectory in simulation before hardware testing.

4 · APPROVE

Real test & move on

Upload the validated file, test on the real arm, then PASS, tune, or record again. PASS unlocks the next region.
